newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Feb 18.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Bunker prices held steady on Tuesday with fuel oil swaps weakening, traders said. A major said shipowners were bidding at low levels in anticipation of further cuts to cargo prices. He said 380-cts bids were seen at $101.75 per tonne. In the cargo market, bid/offer was heard at $103/$106 for different lifting dates, down about $1.00 from Monday.
